user.title: Connect to Audiobookshelf
user.description: In Audiobookshelf, go to Settings → API Keys and create a new key. Leave the expiry blank so the key never expires - an expiring key will eventually stop the integration until you enter a new one.

data_description.api_key: Settings → API Keys → New API Key. An admin key is needed for server-wide sensors.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Audiobookshelf
reauth_confirm.description: Your Audiobookshelf API key is no longer valid. Create a new one under Settings → API Keys and enter it below.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Audiobookshelf
reconfigure.description: Change the server address or replace the API key. It must be a key for the same Audiobookshelf server.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the server. Check the URL and that Audiobookshelf is running.
error.not_audiobookshelf: Something answered at that address, but it is not an Audiobookshelf server.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Audiobookshelf server is already set up.
abort.wrong_server: That is a different Audiobookshelf server. To move to another server, add it as a new integration.

not_loaded.message: The Audiobookshelf integration is not loaded.

no_linked_users.message: No Audiobookshelf users are linked. Open the integration's options and link at least one user before using this action.

unknown_user.message: {user} is not a linked Audiobookshelf user. Linked users: {linked}.

ambiguous_user.message: Could not tell which Audiobookshelf user this is for. Pass a user, or map your Home Assistant account to an Audiobookshelf user in the integration's options.

cannot_pause.message: {entity_id} cannot be paused, so it is almost certainly a notification or talkback speaker rather than something to listen to an audiobook on. Refusing to play.

nothing_in_progress.message: {user} has nothing in progress on Audiobookshelf.

session_failed.message: Could not start a playback session: {error}

no_audio_tracks.message: Audiobookshelf returned no audio tracks for that item.

scan_failed.message: Could not start the library scan: {error}

need_series_or_item.message: Pass either a series or an item_id, not both and not neither.

api_key_expiring.title: Your Audiobookshelf API key is about to expire
api_key_expiring.description:
The API key Home Assistant uses for {url} expires on {expires}. When it does, this integration will stop working until you enter a new one.

Create a replacement in Audiobookshelf under Settings → API Keys, leaving the expiry blank so it never lapses, then reconfigure the integration with the new key.

init.title: Link Audiobookshelf users
init.description: Pick the people whose books you want to resume on a speaker. Audiobookshelf only lets an account update its own listening progress, so Home Assistant has to act as each person. An API key is created for everyone you select, and revoked if you unselect them. No passwords are needed.

map.title: Match them to Home Assistant accounts
map.description: Optional. Mapping {users} to Home Assistant accounts lets the Continue listening action work out whose book to resume when someone presses a dashboard button. Automations run without a user, so leave this unset if you always pass the user explicitly.

error.key_failed: Could not create an API key. The configured key must belong to an Audiobookshelf admin.

continue_listening.name: Continue listening
continue_listening.description: Resume a linked user's current audiobook on a media player, picking up where they left off and syncing progress back to Audiobookshelf.

entity_id.name: Media player
entity_id.description: The speaker to play on. It must support playing media; without seek support, playback restarts from the beginning of the track.

user.name: Audiobookshelf user
user.description: Whose book to resume. Defaults to the Home Assistant account that invoked this action, if it is mapped, or to the only linked user.

seek.name: Resume at position
seek.description: Seek to the saved position after playback starts. Turn off to start the track from the beginning.

remove_progress.name: Remove progress
remove_progress.description: Delete a linked user's saved progress on one item, or on every book in a series. This cannot be undone.

user.name: Audiobookshelf user
user.description: Whose progress to delete. Defaults to the Home Assistant account that invoked this action, if it is mapped, or to the only linked user.

series.name: Series
series.description: Delete progress on every book in this series. Matched on the series name exactly, ignoring case.

item_id.name: Item ID
item_id.description: Delete progress on a single library item instead of a series.
